title: "Toy Multiverse: Null Baseline"
format: pdf

```{r setup}
source("R/_load.R")
```

## Generate Toy multiverse

```{r toy-generate}
set.seed(42)

toy_decisions <- list(
  decision_1 = paste0("option_", seq_len(2)),
  decision_2 = paste0("option_", seq_len(3)),
  decision_3 = paste0("option_", seq_len(4)),
  decision_4 = paste0("option_", seq_len(4)),
  decision_5 = paste0("option_", seq_len(5))
)

mv_toy <- do.call(expand_grid, toy_decisions) |>
  rename_with(~ paste0("mv_dim_", .x)) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), as.factor)) |>
  mutate(toy_outcome = rnorm(n()))

mv_toy
```

# Overview

```{r toy-decisions-overview}
mv_toy |>
  get_multiverse_decisions()
```

```{r toy-full-design-check}
check_full_design(mv_toy)
```

```{r toy-multiverse-tree}
#| fig-width: 11
vis_multiverse_tree(mv_toy)
```

```{r toy-multiverse-simple}
#| fig-width: 9
vis_multiverse_simple(mv_toy, direction = "right")
```

# Existing Methods

## Regression

```{r toy-regression-fit}
reg_toy <- calc_regression(mv_toy, colname_metric = "toy_outcome")
attr(reg_toy, "tidy")
```

```{r toy-regression-summary}
summary(reg_toy)
```

```{r toy-regression-coefficients}
vis_regression_coefficients(reg_toy)
```

### Importance

```{r toy-regression-importance}
regimp_toy <- calc_regression_importance(
  mv_toy,
  colname_metric = "toy_outcome"
)
regimp_toy
```

```{r toy-regression-importance-plot}
vis_importance(regimp_toy)
```

## FANOVA

```{r toy-fanova-fit}
fanova_toy <- calc_fanova(mv_toy, colname_metric = "toy_outcome")
fanova_toy
```

```{r toy-fanova-importance-plot}
fanova_toy |>
  filter(is.na(level_1)) |>
  fanova_to_vec() |>
  vis_importance()
```

# Our Framework

```{r toy-decide}
decide_toy <- decide(mv_toy, colname_metric = "toy_outcome")
decide_toy
```

```{r toy-decide-plot}
decide_vec(mv_toy, colname_metric = "toy_outcome") |>
  vis_importance()
```

## Combine

```{r toy-combine-importance}
vis_importance_2dim(
  decide_vec(mv_toy, colname_metric = "toy_outcome"),
  fanova_toy |> filter(is.na(level_1)) |> fanova_to_vec()
)
```

## Composite importance table

```{r toy-importance-composite}
compose_importance_table(
  decide = decide_toy,
  fanova_main = calc_fanova_main_importance(mv_toy, colname_metric = "toy_outcome"),
  fanova_total = fanova_toy |> fanova_total_to_vec(),
  regression = regimp_toy,
  caption = "Importance estimates per decision, by method (toy null baseline).",
  label = "importance-toy"
)
```

# Ablation Study (not sure we need this)

```{r toy-ablation-run}
ablation_toy <- run_ablation_analysis(
  mv_toy,
  colname_metric = "toy_outcome"
)
```

## Inter-method stability

```{r toy-ablation-inter-method-table}
ablation_toy$inter_method_stability_summary |>
  mutate(
    fixed_decision_label = if_else(
      fixed_decision == "full_multiverse",
      "full multiverse",
      fixed_decision_label
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    fixed_decision_label,
    method_x,
    method_y,
    mean_rank_correlation,
    min_rank_correlation
  )
```

```{r toy-ablation-inter-method-plot}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.5
vis_inter_method_stability(ablation_toy$inter_method_stability_summary)
```

```{r toy-ablation-inter-method-matrix}
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 4.5
vis_inter_method_matrix(ablation_toy$inter_method_stability_summary)
```

## Intra-method stability

```{r toy-ablation-intra-method-table}
ablation_toy$intra_method_stability_summary |>
  select(
    fixed_decision_label,
    method,
    mean_rank_correlation,
    min_rank_correlation,
    mean_abs_difference
  )
```

```{r toy-ablation-intra-method-plot}
vis_intra_method_stability(ablation_toy$intra_method_stability_summary)
```
